remarks: FOR SALE OR LEASE - 543 Newfield Avenue, Stamford, CT 06905 Nizzardo Real Estate Services is pleased to present this rare mixed-use investment opportunity located at the highly visible and heavily trafficked intersection of Newfield Avenue and Oaklawn Avenue in Stamford, Connecticut. This standalone 4-unit building sits on 0.19 acres with ample on-site parking. The main level is currently configured for office use but can easily be converted into a residential unit. The second floor features two one-bedroom apartments, while the lower level offers flexible office space ideal for professional or small business use. Perfect for owner-occupants, investors, or small business owners, this property allows the unique opportunity to live and work in the same location. Location Highlights: * Prime visibility along a busy Stamford corridor with consistent traffic and exposure * Minutes to downtown Stamford, the Merritt Parkway, and I-95 * Surrounded by established neighborhoods, retail, and local amenities * Walkable access to dining, shops, and public transportation * Strong rental demand for both residential and commercial uses Whether you're seeking a live/work setup, an income-producing investment, or a flexible owner-user property, 543 Newfield Avenue delivers unmatched potential in one of Stamford's most convenient and desirable locations.
